title: GeoNames geographical database – Canada (CA.zip) and US (US.zip) exports: populated places
attribution: Place names: GeoNames (geonames.org), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Only places with population of 1,000 or more (Canada) or 2,000 or more (US) are used, with coordinates rounded.
notes: Owner decision B45: From/To suggestions on the trip planner; US towns added by B78 (DESIGN-7 D5). Downloaded by hand with npm run fetch:geonames [-- --country=us], which writes data/imported/geonames/places-ca.json / places-us.json (with the zip's checksum); refreshed when needed.
